changelog: Added qs-housing and high-phone integrations, updated gksphone to v2
Radio roster shows character name, callsign, unit and live speaking state
Fingerprint prints and MDT vehicle images on profiles and records
Evidence markers and police tape can use up inventory items
Dispatch alert jobs can target resources outside the MDT
ESX support before 1.8.5 and manual installs without the txAdmin recipe
Fixed off-duty officers not triggering automatic alerts
Fixed items breaking when the inventory starts after the MDT
Config changes: ExcludeJobs replaced by OnDutyExempt
Many more fixes, see the full changelog
